items.stem: Match each part of the plant to its function.
items.note: Mark scheme: all three correct = 1 mark.

items.stem:
Water is one condition a plant needs to be healthy.

Write down two other conditions the plant needs to be healthy.
items.note: Mark scheme: light; (correct) temperature. Each correct answer = 1 mark. Accept warmth or cold, and higher-level answers such as minerals or named minerals. A person should check this answer against the mark scheme.

items.stem:
Mia pulls a block across different surfaces. She measures the force she uses to pull the block across each surface.

What equipment does Mia use to measure the force?

Here are Mia’s results.

paper 7 newtons
concrete 9 newtons
glass 5 newtons
wood 8 newtons

Mia concludes that glass is the smoothest surface. Is Mia correct? Use the results in the table to explain your answer.

accepted: Yes — glass needed the lowest force to pull the block
yes, the lowest force was needed for glass
yes, 5 newtons is the smallest force

items.note: Mark scheme: yes, with the idea that the lowest force was needed to pull the block. If ‘no’ is chosen, 0 marks. A person should check this answer against the mark scheme.

items.stem: What is the name of the force that Mia is investigating?

A bottle of lemonade has a plastic lid, air above the drink and the lemonade itself.

Materials are solids, liquids or gases. Complete the sentences, choosing from: solid, liquid, gas.

The plastic lid is a ____.
The air is a ____.
The lemonade is a ____.
items.note: Mark scheme: solid; gas; liquid. All three correct = 2 marks, two correct = 1 mark, one correct = 0 marks. A person should check this answer against the mark scheme.

items.stem:
Useful materials are found in rocks. One useful material found in rocks is oil.

Name two other useful materials found in rocks.
items.note: Mark scheme: natural gas; metals. Each correct answer = 1 mark. Accept named metals and suitable alternatives such as stone. A person should check this answer against the mark scheme.

items.stem:
Oliver uses the internet to find out about the organs in the human body.

Which type of scientific enquiry is he using?

Oliver writes down some information in his notebook: the organ pumps blood around the body.

Which organ pumps blood around the body?

Blessy wants to separate a mixture of sand and water.

Complete the sentence about this separation method.

This method separates the sand and water because sand is ____ in water.

Blessy mixes salt and water. She cannot see the salt in the water.

Explain why she cannot see the salt in the water.

accepted: the salt has dissolved in the water

items.note: Mark scheme: the idea that the salt has dissolved in the water.

items.stem:
Chen has a horseshoe magnet, with one end marked N and the other marked S.

Complete the sentences.

The letter N is the ____ pole of the magnet.
The letter S is the ____ pole of the magnet.
items.note: Mark scheme: north; south. Both answers correct for the mark.

accepted: the remains of a dead plant or animal
the remains of a dead animal
the remains of a dead plant
an impression of something that was once alive

items.note: Mark scheme: the remains of a dead plant or animal. Accept an impression of something that was once alive.

items.stem:
Look at the food chain.

grass → snail → bird → fox

What is the producer in this food chain?

Look at the food chain.

grass → snail → bird → fox

Write down the names of all the consumers in this food chain.
items.note: Mark scheme: snail and bird and fox. All three correct = 1 mark.

items.stem:
Yuri sorts objects into three groups.

opaque: shirt, chair
transparent: glass, clean water
third group: tissue paper

Complete the table by adding the heading to the last column.

Yuri wants to make a shadow using one of these objects.

Write down the name of one object Yuri uses to make a shadow, and explain your choice.
items.note: Mark scheme: shirt or chair; the idea that it blocks the light. Each correct answer = 1 mark. Accept examples of opaque objects not in the table. A person should check this answer against the mark scheme.

name organ X on a drawing of the body and describe its function [2]
name the separation method from a picture of the equipment [1]
describe and explain what two pictured magnets do, from their drawn orientation [2]
the same magnets drawn in a second orientation [1]
identify the organism from the pictured fossil [1]
